States for every control: default, pressed (8% overlay), focused (2 dp Glow ring), disabled (38% opacity), error (Coral), loading (skeleton or ring).
Motion: 120 ms micro, 200 ms standard, 320 ms screen. Spring for sheets and Whisper Send. Reduce-motion switches springs to fades.
